items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I remember working the first dates bass with Louis Jordan's band.

ctx.x: But sometimes, you know, you can always have two fine instrumentalists, a drummer and a bass player, but together they -- they just don't, you know, mesh.

Well, then that becomes an ego thing. I remember working the first dates bass with Louis Jordan's band. The original Timpany Five, He didn't have a bass player on (inaudible) just for records, and I was chosen for Decca. And the engineers at Decca said I had the most perfect beat of all the rest of the bass players, so I became the house bass player there with all the

blues singers
bass players and whatnot.
